newsitem.title: UK: Central Asian cottons feature in European market.
newsitem.headline: Central Asian cottons feature in European market.

text.p: Central Asian or better qualities of cotton moved off steadily in Portugal, Italy and Germany, industry sources said on Thursday.
Mills in Spain made moderate purchases of domestic new crop for delivery around the year end, they added.
However, turnover was limited in most European markets, with spinners still reluctant to anticipate forward requirements.
Eastern European markets were generally slow apart from scattered enquiries for long staple varieties.
